permission: Separate explicit user scientific execution permission required. Chat permission suffices; no proof, stored approval text or new grant.
initialization: Both new independent fits use the same original qualified J/U/x0 unchanged. No warm-start, new Cholesky/logm, resuming consumed fits, gauge change or parameter rescaling.
solver: Existing ffsim0.0.83 L-BFGS-B objective/AD. New process-local last-hop options, no bounds, callback=None. Defaults maxcor/maxls/maxiter/maxfun retained explicitly. Positive ftol is not gradient convergence proof.
first_order_definition: Native 128-coordinate gradient infinity plus restricted identity-tensor-transfer projected derivative in Frobenius-normalized symmetric-J metric. Both with declared engineering margin. No full Riemannian U/gauge quotient stationarity or global optimum certificate.
identity_projection: For independent upper-J derivatives b_tij: c_t=sum_upper(b_tij)/norb, z_t=c_t-mean(c). norm2(z) is the derivative norm on dJ_t=a_t*11^T/norb with sum(a)=0, sum(a^2)=1. No coordinate or gauge transformation is applied.
qualification: Post-fit criteria and solver success reported separately. qualified requires both criteria MET plus normal solver success; physical DF budget admission remains separate.
decision: Budget NOT_MET takes priority; otherwise unqualified solver/first-order => ONE_OR_BOTH_UNQUALIFIED. Qualified comparison only if both arms qualify and both DF budgets PASS. Descriptive lambda is retained regardless, no resource/scientific superiority claim.
physical: Saved linear H4/1Angstrom/STO-3G, Nalpha=Nbeta=2 sector36, number general symmetric J, rank8, original frame order/LD2, original-g corrected kappa and scalar once. No PF time evolution.
DF_budget: sector_error + inherited sector_operation_scale_guard8_proposal_v1 <= .00019875Ha; preserve representation gate component_atol1e-10 and old physical reference implementation. No rigorous enclosure/CA claim.
call_order: initial_qualification_gate using saved initial sector PASS, qualified x0 bytes

independent rc2/pr dedicated fit processes: load, setup, optimized_fitter containing initial diagnostic and one SciPy invocation then raw terminal export and independent terminal diagnostic; final tensor assessment
after all workers finish without correctness FAIL: final_snapshot_load, sector_assessment, representation_assessment for each role
comparison of convergence/budget/tail and old saved scalars only
save source/raw/calls/resources/STOP; publish and mandatory STOP
permitted_future_science: two independent new CDF fits from original x0
before/independent terminal diagnostics including internal objective and gradient evaluations
physical sector once, two terminal sector errors/general-K vs raw CAR
saved scalar comparison only for old gamma0/RC2/PR; old final arrays not decoded
excluded: important scientific review, novelty or publication qualification
unqualified_exit: Finite solver failure (line-search/iteration/evaluation limit) still exports/diagnoses terminal and DF budget; no additional optimizer attempt. Neither relative success nor budget alone qualifies convergence.
correctness_STOP: Source/input/schema/representation/nonfinite/independent-gradient mismatch or worker exception => TECHNICAL_FAILURE; prevent dependent launches/evaluation. Collect already-started independent worker diagnostics/STOPs safely. No retry.
preservation: All old SOURCE, inputs, scientific contracts, fits/raw/QPY/grants/ledgers/markers/STOP/Git history untouched.
resources: Choose up to two independent fit processes from actual CPU/quota/RAM using existing resource_plan plus saved-peak memory estimate; no artificial CPU/RAM/worker/wall caps. Per-process tiny BLAS=1 coordinates JAX CPU pools. Separate role caches/tmp; no shared settings/venv/other-user changes.
release: Fixed SOURCE and this contract remain unchanged during science; publish results/raw/calls/STOP, verify remote SHA/tree and mandatory STOP.
